latest.title: Long-time dynamics of partially dissipative hyperbolic systems with non-autonomous coefficients
latest.abstract: We study quasilinear symmetrizable partially dissipative hyperbolic systems with non-autonomous relaxation coefficients in $\mathbb{R}^d$ ($d\geq1$). The existence of global strong solutions is established in a critical regularity setting for systems satisfying the so-called Shizuta-Kawashima (SK) and entropy conditions. When the initial data are additionally bounded in a lower-regularity norm, we prove that the corresponding solutions converge to equilibrium at optimal algebraic decay rates. Furthermore, we show that the conservative part of the solution behaves asymptotically as the solution of a non-autonomous parabolic equation. Our results apply to the compressible Euler system with the time-dependent damping coefficient $\frac{K}{(1+t)^{\alpha}}$ ($\alpha<1$, $K>0$ or $\alpha=1$, $K\gg 1$) in the velocity equation. The natural low/high-frequency splitting of the autonomous theory persists in the non-autonomous setting, but with a frequency-threshold that evolves in time. To handle this moving frequency structure, we introduce a new class of hybrid Besov spaces adapted to time-dependent thresholds and derive hypocoercive estimates in each frequency regime. Our results reveal the qualitative and quantitative effects of general time-dependent relaxation coefficients on dissipation and large-time dynamics.
latest.workSummary: 论文处理带时间依赖松弛系数 b(t) 的可对称化部分耗散双曲系统。作者在 Shizuta–Kawashima 条件和熵结构下建立临界 Besov 全局强解，再以随时间移动的频率阈值构造混合 Besov 估计，得到最优代数衰减，并将守恒分量约化为非自治抛物型渐近方程。
latest.breakthrough: 解决非自治松弛下频率阈值移动导致的低/高频耦合，给出全局强解、最优代数衰减和守恒变量的抛物极限。
latest.limitations: 初值须小且满足临界 Besov/低正则性附加界；衰减速率依赖 b(t) 的单调性和积分增长，非小数据及一般非 SK 系统未覆盖。

steps.claim: Theorem 1 用 SK 条件和熵对称化在临界 Besov 空间构造全局强解。
steps.route: 把线性化符号沿频率方向分解，SK 条件为守恒模态提供间接耗散；对 dyadic 块施加对称化能量并把二次通量估计到临界范数，连续迭代保持小数据闭合。

steps.claim: Proposition 2 将带 b(t) 的线性系统估计转为移动阈值的低/高频衰减。
steps.route: 对线性方程使用时间积分因子并按 b(t) 决定的阈值切分频率；低频使用扩散近似，高频使用松弛耗散，两个区域在阈值穿越时由混合 Besov 范数拼接。

steps.claim: Proposition 5 和 Lemmas 6–7 给出非线性稳定性、长时间衰减和守恒分量的抛物近似。
steps.route: 先对两组解差值应用 stability estimate，再把非线性源项按低中高频分别积分；Lemmas 6–7 对 b(t) 的积分核给出时间可积衰减，因而收束 bootstrap 并识别守恒块的有效扩散矩阵。

latest.priorityReason: 部分耗散双曲系统的临界正则性、非自治衰减与全局存在具有明确 PDE 证明链。
